ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central-to-lateral fields with a thick black perimeter along the trailing edge and a dense black concentration surrounding the median notch. Fine-grain black mottling and irregular speckling are distributed across the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; peaks are notably rounded on the left lobe and more jagged on the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into a sharp upward concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular brown and white pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the outer distal margins and lower leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, vertically oriented dark linear disruptions visible on the inner-white field of the right lobe, consistent with minor rake marking.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) concentrated on the distal extremities; irregular black scarring and notch-wear along the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern located specifically in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe white field.
